## What we know

- **Name:** 恩佑寺 Enyou Si (S05, S02, S1202, S03, S1207 · confidence A)

- **What it was:** a temple outside the garden walls (S05, S02, S1202, S03, S1207 · confidence A)
- **In 1860:** burned Oct 1860 (明善's memorial via S1207); the glazed gate survives, district-protected 1981 (S1200 lead) (S05, S02, S1202, S03, S1207)

- **Note:** Built by Yongzheng for Kangxi 'at the east wall of 畅春园' (S05 j76: 建于畅春园之东垣); main hall with three Buddhas. Malone photographs pp.105-106. (S05, S02, S1202, S03, S1207)
